sources.title: AMPARs and synaptic plasticity: the last 25 years
sources.key_content: Comprehensive review of AMPAR regulation in LTP and LTD; phosphorylation states (GluA1 Ser831/Ser845, GluA2 Ser880); calcineurin/PP2B/PP1 cascade; clathrin-mediated endocytosis; PICK1/GRIP1/GRIP2 interactions; cerebellar LTD; mGluR-LTD; GluA2 knockout paradox; metabotropic NMDAR hypothesis
sources.use_in_article: Core reference for LTD mechanisms overview and AMPAR phosphorylation state changes
sources.preparation: multiple (in vitro, ex vivo, in vivo)

sources.title: A critical role for PSD-95/AKAP interactions in endocytosis of synaptic AMPA receptors
sources.authors: Bhattacharyya S, Biou V, Xu W, Schlüter O, Malenka RC
sources.key_content: PSD-95/AKAP150/calcineurin triad positions PP2B adjacent to NMDAR for LTD; SH3-GK domain of PSD-95 essential for AKAP150 binding; PSD-95 knockdown blocks NMDAR-triggered but not mGluR-triggered AMPAR endocytosis; AKAP-ΔPP2B mutant blocks NMDA-LTD; mechanistic dissociation of two LTD pathways
sources.use_in_article: Key evidence for PSD-95/AKAP150/calcineurin complex mechanism and pathway specificity
sources.limitation: Primarily cultured neurons; limited in vivo validation
sources.preparation: hippocampal neuron cultures, acute hippocampal slices

sources.title: Actin-dependent mechanisms in AMPA receptor trafficking and synaptic plasticity
sources.key_content: Actin cytoskeleton dynamics in AMPAR endocytosis; Arc/Arg3.1 binding to dynamin and endophilin drives clathrin-mediated AMPAR internalization; Arp2/3-mediated actin branching in endocytic pit formation; cofilin regulation (LIMK/SSH) in LTD; actin as bidirectional plasticity regulator
sources.use_in_article: Mechanism of Arc-driven AMPAR endocytosis; actin cytoskeleton in LTD
sources.limitation: Review; some mechanistic details from non-neuronal cell systems

sources.title: The Arc of synaptic memory
sources.authors: Bramham CR, Alme MN, Bittins M, Kuipers SD, Nair RR, Pai B, Panja D, Schubert M, Soule J, Tiron A, Bhattacharya S
sources.key_content: Arc/Arg3.1 as activity sensor and synaptic plasticity modulator; Arc mRNA dendritically targeted and locally translated; Arc in LTD via AMPAR endocytosis (dynamin/endophilin interaction); Arc in LTP consolidation via cofilin/PAK pathway; Arc knockout impairs LTP consolidation and LTD; Arc as homeostatic scaler of synaptic strength
sources.use_in_article: Arc/Arg3.1 as master regulator of mGluR-LTD; dual function in LTP and LTD
sources.limitation: Review; Arc's precise molecular switch between LTP-function and LTD-function not fully resolved

sources.title: LTP and LTD: an embarrassment of riches
sources.key_content: Comprehensive framework for LTP/LTD diversity across brain regions; Ca2+ threshold hypothesis (high Ca2+ → LTP kinases, low Ca2+ → LTD phosphatases); low-frequency stimulation protocol (1 Hz, 900 pulses) for NMDA-LTD; cerebellar LTD as NMDAR-independent prototype
sources.use_in_article: Historical context and conceptual framework for LTD/LTP bidirectionality; Ca2+ threshold hypothesis

sources.title: The mGluR theory of fragile X mental retardation
sources.authors: Bear MF, Huber KM, Warren ST
sources.key_content: FMRP as translational repressor of Arc and other LTD-related mRNAs; mGluR-LTD exaggeration in Fmr1 knockout mice; mGluR5 antagonist rescue of FXS phenotypes in mice; clinical prediction of mGluR5 as therapeutic target for FXS
sources.use_in_article: mGluR-LTD mechanism in fragile X syndrome; FMRP/mGluR5 pathway
sources.limitation: Abstract only; full text paywalled; clinical translation proved more difficult than predicted in mice
sources.preparation: in vivo, ex vivo hippocampal slices
